name: PostGIS
shortDescription: GeoServer map server with a bundled PostGIS database exposed as a JNDI connection pool for storing and publishing vector data.

alerts.message: Log in as admin with the generated GEOSERVER_ADMIN_PASSWORD. On every start the image rewrites the admin account from these variables and resets users and roles added in the web console; remove GEOSERVER_ADMIN_USER and GEOSERVER_ADMIN_PASSWORD after first login if you manage users in GeoServer.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
